ModelColumn.description:
A matrix column. `model_config_id` is the gateway deployment ID recorded on the ledger
row, or `None` when no matched ledger row carried one.

ProfileCoverage.description:
How much of the window the figures rest on. When `truncated` is set, `runs_listed` is a
lower bound and the request, cost and latency figures cover only `runs_resolved` runs.

required_capabilities.description: `None` until a reviewed task definition states the requirements.

revision.description: Changes on every write, so a stale browser edit is rejected.

version.description: Generation that assignments are keyed by; it only grows, even across resets.
